name: Aomori

flag.description: A green map of the prefecture on a white field.
flag.symbolism: The emblem is the outline of Aomori itself, with the Tsugaru and Shimokita peninsulas reaching north around Mutsu Bay; the white stands for the boundless universe and the deep green for hope and the future.

hook: Aomori's flag is just its own map in green on white, the two peninsulas at the tip of Honshu standing up like horns.
trivia: Aomori grows more than half of Japan's apples.
Its flag is one of the few prefectural flags drawn as a map rather than a stylized character.
